headline: Code violations and foreclosure action at 267 Main St, plus blight, culvert holes, and water shut-off issues at other properties.
summary: The agenda lists old business on four properties, including violations at 267 Main St and 92 Gaylord St. It also covers a blight case at 252 and 252 ½ Terryville Rd, four properties on the long-term watch list, a relocation act item, and tax liens.
items: 267 Main St: PMC violations, board and secure, foreclosure action (high priority)
92 Gaylord St: PMC, FMO, BBHD, and zoning
820 Stafford Ave: PMC, roof, and sinking stoop
252 and 252 ½ Terryville Rd: blight (high priority)
9 Divinity St: motion approved 07.01.2026, next step to be set pending compliance
Long-term watch list: 211 Park St, hole in culvert and new owner
Long-term watch list: 213 Park St, hole in culvert
Long-term watch list: 215 Park St, hole in culvert and new owner
Long-term watch list: 59 North Main St, water shut off and deteriorating (high priority)
URAA, Uniform Relocation Assisting Act: Stephen Bynum (BPRYCS)
Tax liens: Ann Bednaz, Tax Collector (BTC)
